nurse_iwasaki_rumi.open: “Sure! I will walk you through what happens next, step by step. If anything is unclear, just interrupt me. No need to be shy.”
nurse_iwasaki_rumi.insert_a: “This part does sound a little scary. But taking our time to explain it now is better than leaving you guessing on the operating table, right?”
nurse_iwasaki_rumi.insert_b: “Hey, do not just nod along. If you feel cold, hurt, or frightened, tell us. You do not have to put up with any of that to be a good patient.”
nurse_iwasaki_rumi.close: “All right, those are the main steps. Is there anything you would like me to go over again? Asking now can help you feel more at ease later.”

nurse_yoneda_shiori.open: “Of course. I will explain the planned procedure one step at a time. Please ask whenever anything is unclear.”
nurse_yoneda_shiori.insert_a: “This part may feel unsettling. You do not need to remember every step at once, though. I can explain anything you did not catch again.”
nurse_yoneda_shiori.insert_b: “If any step makes you nervous, or you feel physically uncomfortable, please tell us directly. I will make a careful note of the questions you raise.”
nurse_yoneda_shiori.close: “That concludes the explanation. Let me check once more: is there any step you are still worried about? Please tell us so we can go over it together.”
